$comment: OMN-17499. The set of models a BACKGROUND agent may run on.
Read by plugins/onex/hooks/lib/workflow_model_guard.py, which is invoked by
the pre_tool_use_agent_model_guard.sh PreToolUse hook. The list lives here,
not in the checker, so changing policy is a config edit rather than a code
change -- and so the policy is visible in one place instead of inferred from
JSON rather than YAML deliberately, unlike the sibling .yaml files in this
directory: the checker sits on a fail-closed enforcement path, so it must
parse its own policy with the standard library alone. A missing PyYAML in
the resolved interpreter would otherwise turn into a refusal of every
Workflow and Agent dispatch on the machine.
There is deliberately NO 'inherit' entry. An inherited model is the defect
this guard exists to refuse: on 2026-09-01, 41 agent() calls with no model:
silently inherited the parent session's banned model. Adding a spelling that
passes would reintroduce exactly that. Every background agent names its own
Fable is a foreground-orchestration model and is banned for background work.
